axioms.subject: EmbeddingLanguageModel
axioms.evidence: In this work, we align Large Language Models to embeddings of clinical trials using the recently reported Embedding Language Model (ELM) method.

axioms.subject: ctELM
axioms.evidence: We then train a series of ELMs exploring the impact of tasks and training regimes. Our final model, ctELM, can accurately describe and compare unseen clinical trials
